prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web application direction comp, 1440x1000 landscape
Primary request: Design the executive dashboard first viewport for a Thai university planning, budget, project, disbursement, and KPI system. The visual world is one-sheet-many-steps: a single vermilion-orange record preserves every stage and revision like an origami crease, from budget request to project approval to quarterly delivery, disbursement, and KPI evidence.
Composition/framing: left margin contains a strict numbered stage column; center is one large white-orange structured sheet divided by crisp diagonal and orthogonal fold lines into four quarterly zones; the active stage opens as a clear data table/decision queue, not decorative origami; right side shows a recoverable revision timeline and selected record facts. Use a precise step indicator and reversible history. The interface must remain familiar enough for real administrative work.
Style/medium: production-ready SaaS UI mockup; sharp paper geometry translated to flat digital panels; quiet humanist Thai typography; precise numbers and status labels; no photoreal paper.
Color palette: vermilion orange #D94A12, deep orange #C2410C, white #FFFFFF, warm white #FFF7ED, ink #292524, gold #CA8A04, green/red only for status.
Materials/textures: crisp digital folds, strict numbered margin, crease rules, one gold active marker; almost no texture.
Text (verbatim where legible): ระบบบริหารแผน, หนึ่งแผ่น หลายขั้น, ข้อมูลตัวอย่าง, 1 คำของบ, 2 อนุมัติ, 3 ดำเนินงาน, 4 เบิกจ่าย, 5 KPI, ไตรมาส 1, รายการรอพิจารณา, ประวัติการแก้ไข.
Constraints: Thai-first; executive decision dashboard; accessible; tabular figures; explicit status words; orange and white; no logo invention; no browser chrome.
Avoid: literal origami crane illustration, generic floating metric cards, gradients, glassmorphism, huge rounded cards, dark mode, purple/blue brand accents, excessive pills, decorative folds that harm readability.
